mapper.select: select distinct r.site_code from monitor_rule r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.enabled = true order by r.site_code

select r.rule_id, r.site_code, r.rule_no, r.metric_code, c.metric_name, c.value_format, u.email as owner_email, r.judge_type, r.warn_low, r.warn_high, r.crit_low, r.crit_high, r.period_hours, r.duration_count, r.escalate_hours, r.mute_hours, r.min_sample_key, r.min_sample_value, r.notify_chat_id, r.notify_chat_name, r.last_notified_at, s.rule_id as state_rule_id, s.run_start_hour, s.recent_levels::text as recent_levels, s.recent_periods::text as recent_periods, s.last_period_end, s.last_data_hour, e.event_id, e.level as event_level, e.peak_level as event_peak_level, e.escalated as event_escalated, e.start_hour as event_start_hour, e.trigger_hour as event_trigger_hour, e.handle_status as event_handle_status, e.handled_level as event_handled_level, e.handle_reset as event_handle_reset, e.notify_status as event_notify_status from monitor_rule r left join dashboard_metric_card c on c.metric_code = r.metric_code left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_user_id left join monitor_rule_state s on s.rule_id = r.rule_id and s.site_code = r.site_code left join monitor_event e on e.rule_id = r.rule_id and e.site_code = r.site_code and e.event_type = 'alert' and e.status = 'open' where r.del_flag = '0' and r.enabled = true
order by r.rule_no

select r.rule_id, r.site_code, r.rule_no, r.metric_code, c.metric_name, c.value_format, u.email as owner_email, r.judge_type, r.warn_low, r.warn_high, r.crit_low, r.crit_high, r.period_hours, r.duration_count, r.escalate_hours, r.mute_hours, r.min_sample_key, r.min_sample_value, r.notify_chat_id, r.notify_chat_name, r.last_notified_at, s.rule_id as state_rule_id, s.run_start_hour, s.recent_levels::text as recent_levels, s.recent_periods::text as recent_periods, s.last_period_end, s.last_data_hour, e.event_id, e.level as event_level, e.peak_level as event_peak_level, e.escalated as event_escalated, e.start_hour as event_start_hour, e.trigger_hour as event_trigger_hour, e.handle_status as event_handle_status, e.handled_level as event_handled_level, e.handle_reset as event_handle_reset, e.notify_status as event_notify_status from monitor_rule r left join dashboard_metric_card c on c.metric_code = r.metric_code left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_user_id left join monitor_rule_state s on s.rule_id = r.rule_id and s.site_code = r.site_code left join monitor_event e on e.rule_id = r.rule_id and e.site_code = r.site_code and e.event_type = 'alert' and e.status = 'open' where r.del_flag = '0' and r.rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_hour_check (site_code, data_hour, status, check_count) values (#{scope.siteCode}, #{hour}, 'waiting', 0) on conflict (site_code, data_hour) do nothing

insert into monitor_rule_state (rule_id, site_code, run_start_hour, recent_levels, recent_periods, open_event_id, last_period_end, last_data_hour, update_time) values (#{st.ruleId}, #{scope.siteCode}, #{st.runStartHour,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, cast(#{st.recentLevels} as jsonb), cast(#{st.recentPeriods} as jsonb), #{st.openEventId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{st.lastPeriodEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{st.lastDataHour,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{st.updateTime}) on conflict (rule_id) do update set run_start_hour = excluded.run_start_hour, recent_levels = excluded.recent_levels, recent_periods = excluded.recent_periods, open_event_id = excluded.open_event_id, last_period_end = excluded.last_period_end, last_data_hour = excluded.last_data_hour, update_time = excluded.update_time where monitor_rule_state.site_code = excluded.site_code

insert into monitor_event (site_code, rule_id, metric_code, event_type, level, peak_level, escalated, status, start_hour, trigger_hour, end_hour, last_period_end, current_value, baseline_value, rule_snapshot, notify_status, mute_sent_at, mute_hours, handle_status, handle_reset, create_time, update_time) values (#{siteCode}, #{ruleId}, #{metricCode}, 'alert', #{level}, #{peakLevel}, #{escalated}, 'open', #{startHour}, #{triggerHour}, null, #{lastPeriodEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{currentValue,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{baselineValue,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, cast(#{ruleSnapshot} as jsonb), #{notifyStatus}, #{muteSentAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{muteHours,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, 'pending', false, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: update monitor_event set level = #{e.level}, peak_level = #{e.peakLevel}, escalated = #{e.escalated}, status = #{e.status}, end_hour = #{e.endHour,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, last_period_end = #{e.lastPeriodEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, current_value = coalesce(#{e.currentValue,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, current_value), baseline_value = coalesce(#{e.baselineValue,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, baseline_value), notify_status = coalesce(#{e.notifyStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, notify_status), mute_sent_at = coalesce(#{e.muteSentAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, mute_sent_at), mute_hours = coalesce(#{e.muteHours,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, mute_hours), handle_status = #{e.handleStatus}, handle_reset = #{e.handleReset}, update_time = #{e.now} where event_id = #{e.eventId} and site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and event_type = 'alert' and status = 'open'
mapper.select: select count(*) from monitor_notify_log n where n.event_id = #{eventId} and n.status = 'pending'
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_notify_log (site_code, msg_type, event_id, data_hour, chat_id, platform, status, content, retry_count, next_retry_at, create_time, template_id, template_version, notify_type) values (#{siteCode}, #{msgType}, #{eventId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{dataHour,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{chatId}, 'lark', 'pending', #{content}, 0, #{now}, #{now}, #{templateId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{templateVersion,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{notifyType,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
